# Torah for the Table

> A free weekly collection of ready-to-print Divrei Torah for the Shabbos and Yom Tov table, curated for children, families, and adults. New collections are published every Thursday.

Torah for the Table gathers hand-picked Divrei Torah publications for each week's parsha as downloadable PDFs. Every resource is free, printable, and organized by parsha and Jewish year.

## Pages

- [This Week's Collection](/): The current parsha's Divrei Torah, filterable by audience (children, families, adults).
- [Short Vorts](/short-vorts): Bite-sized one-minute Torah insights ("vorts") on the parsha of the week, for saying over at the Shabbos table.
- [Archive](/archive): Past weekly collections, browsable by Jewish year and parsha.
- [About](/about): What Torah for the Table is and who it serves.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach us or submit a publication.
